stages.prompt: Create word-timed subtitles from approved speech (scripts/build_spoken_subtitles.py, or the provider's reviewed SRT for dubbed languages). Read skills/reel-subtitles/SKILL.md first.
Check the SRT: timing, line length, brand spelling, correct language/script, RTL for fa/ar. Fix and report.
Burn subtitles with skills/reel-subtitles/scripts/burn_subtitles.py --preset <brand subtitlePreset> (the brand's locked style). Keep the sidecar SRT separate.
Show the captioned video, subtitles.srt and caption.txt for the language and wait for the user's decision. Write a language-specific caption; never copy another language's.
